topics.purpose: Define the explicit registry mapping every reserved runtime root and namespace family to exactly one authoritative owner contract.

semantics.single_owner_rule: Each active reserved root/family resolves to exactly one authoritative owner contract.
semantics.registry_rule: Registry indexes ownership; it does not absorb owner semantics.
semantics.dynamic_rule: Dynamic namespace families map to family owner contracts, not to transient runtime child instances.
semantics.history_rule: Historical/superseded owner mappings cannot compete with active mappings.
semantics.trace_rule: A generic reader can resolve root -> owner -> semantics and reverse owner -> owned roots.

invariants.rule: Every active reserved runtime root has exactly one explicit owner contract and remains distinguishable from runtime availability, Topic grouping and physical implementation location.

hard_gates.condition: active reserved root has no owner
active reserved root has conflicting owners
historical owner mapping competes with active mapping
dynamic child instance incorrectly registered as family owner

references.purpose: Namespace identities are registered separately from owner mappings.
